expectation_policy: Literal expected deltas and visible log entries; unlisted serializable changes fail. The initial source reference is approved, but scenario outcomes remain observations and grant no rule or correction approval.
random_policy: Constant 0.999999 supplied independently per scenario; explicit bottom-to-top deck arrays, with the final element drawn first.
coverage_limitations: No approved golden scenarios. The earlier shared crew-resource choice is outside the accepted MVP direction and cannot execute against this source; detailed eight-crew semantics remain gated by RD-002.

Controlled states prove local observations, not full-game reachability or exhaustive AI behavior.
